verdict.rationale: Swell documents a visual Theme Editor that lets merchants customize the look and feel of their store without code. Proxima, its official storefront app, supports Shopify Online Store 2.0-style themes and can upgrade and duplicate them. Section-based layout editing is only implied by that OS 2.0 compatibility, and the editor depends on a storefront app implementing themes. Missing for 10: a gallery of professionally designed ready-made themes, explicit docs on section/layout and branding controls in the editor, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
